curriculum.subject: Mathematical Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: model addition as putting objects together

mission.title: model addition as putting objects together

interactions.prompt: Which picture shows 1 mango and 1 mango put together?
interactions.feedback: Yes! Addition puts the two mangoes together in one group.
interactions.retryHint: Look for the picture with both mangoes in the same basket.

interactions.prompt: Put 1 bottle top with 2 bottle tops. Then count the whole group.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap each group to move it into the middle, then tap the total.
interactions.feedback: Great! Putting 1 and 2 together makes one group of 3.
interactions.retryHint: Move both groups together. Now touch each bottle top once as you count.

interactions.prompt: Put 2 pencils with 2 more pencils. How many are in the new group?
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap both pencil groups to join them, then choose the total.
interactions.feedback: Well done! The two groups become one group of 4 pencils.
interactions.retryHint: Count every pencil after the groups join: 1, 2, 3, 4.

interactions.prompt: Join 3 oranges and 2 oranges in one basket. Choose the total.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap each orange group to place it in the basket, then choose the total.
interactions.feedback: Correct! Putting 3 oranges and 2 oranges together makes 5.
interactions.retryHint: Count all the oranges in the basket after both groups go in.

interactions.prompt: At the market, Amina puts 4 mangoes with 3 mangoes. How many mangoes are together?
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap the two groups to put all the mangoes together, then choose the total.
interactions.feedback: You got it! The two groups make one group of 7 mangoes.
interactions.retryHint: After joining the groups, touch and count every mango once.

interactions.prompt: Show what you know. Put 5 bottle tops and 4 bottle tops together. Choose the total.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap both groups to join them, then count and choose the total.
interactions.feedback: Excellent! Addition puts the groups together to make 9 bottle tops.
interactions.retryHint: Make one group first. Then count all the bottle tops from 1 to 9.
